title: Chunking verdicts under count- and budget-matched retrieval: code, analysis plans and results
description:
Code, written analysis plans, deviation logs, run manifests, per-query results and analyses for a multiverse analysis of how the retrieval-selection protocol (a fixed number of chunks vs a fixed word budget) changes chunking verdicts in retrieval-augmented generation. Includes an extension to semantic chunking and dense retrieval (bge-m3), an exploratory answer-quality check (Qwen3-4B; per-row metric values without answer or response text) and a provisional, single-coded protocol audit of recent chunking studies. The original version history is not available, so the timing of the analysis plans cannot be independently verified.

Code is MIT-licensed; project-written results, documents and figures are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). The four source datasets are not included; they are downloaded and checksum-verified by the included fetch script. Dataset question identifiers remain under the datasets' licences (SQuAD 2.0 CC BY-SA 4.0, COVID-QA Apache-2.0, CUAD and Qasper CC BY 4.0).
